text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Last year, Ikuno Dictus showed me the limitless possibilities of management.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From my position of supporting her running,
I want to push the upper limits of my management even a little higher.
With that in mind—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Hm. A New Year's Top-Battling Tournament held at the nearby shrine, is it?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It sounds like a fascinating event.
However—why have you approached me to participate?
choice_data_list: I want to do the same training you did last year.
I want to do the same training you did last year.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...I see. Indeed, during last year's New Year's event, I certainly pushed my management skills to their absolute limit.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
And this year, Trainer, you will manage
my mastery of spinning top techniques?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Training in management. And hopefully,
this event will serve as a nice change of pace for Ikuno Dictus.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. ...Well then, let us see what you can do.
Whenever you are ready.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, as long as it didn't interfere with running practice,
we decided to fit in some spinning top battle training
for the upcoming event as well.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Hmm... I see. The standard theory is to pass the string wound around the top between the ring finger and pinky, is it?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"And on top of that, even the angle of incidence
for maximum power... You researched this thoroughly."
choice_data_list: I've been studying form too, so let's practice together!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Yes. I look forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: I see. To replace a worn-out spinning top spindle, you secure the spindle with pliers and turn the top itself to remove it...
choice_data_list: I'll hold the axle in place, go ahead and turn it!
I'm holding the center steady, so go ahead and spin it!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Yes... Hehe. Routine maintenance is essential for both legs and spinning tops, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And the two of them practiced together
for the event—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Take that!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Dancing like sea spray, a secret art that sweeps away opponents in a flowing motion: the Skimming Top—
It seems to have successfully "ripened."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I have trained relentlessly to reach this point.
I promise you, I will win tomorrow's race.
choice_data_list: You don't have to be on guard that much.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
No. After all the effort Trainer put into
managing things for me, it's the least I can do.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Only by securing a safe victory can we prove the correctness of this management plan.
I will deliver results.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus's eyes are deadly serious.
Winning is certainly important, but my reason for offering management this time wasn't just that—
choice_data_list: …One more thing. One final trial remains.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"I believe our schedule was supposed to end
with that last menu, though...
What are we doing here, Trainer?"
choice_data_list: You and me... let's have a spinning top battle!
You and me... spinning top battle!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
! Battle you, Trainer...!?
Are you telling me that's the final trial?
choice_data_list: This is the final step of our management this time!
This is the finishing touch for our management this time!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: "...Understood. If that is how it's going to be, then I won't hold back either!"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... As expected...!
You didn't join my practice for nothing—
you're so strong...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
However, our evenly matched contest ends here—
I have finally taken a two-win lead.
Isn't this about time for you to concede?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: You really don't know when to quit, do you...? Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Kh... That's two losses in a row for me.
Now Trainer is on a winning streak...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Heh—no way!
One more match!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Phew... Before I knew it, it's gotten completely dark outside.
choice_data_list: I got a little too carried away, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I also, without thinking—
......

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I see.
So this is the finishing touch of your management, Trainer-san?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...You don't need to say a word, I understand.
Indeed. 'Winning' is not the only thing
that matters in a competition.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps that applies to everything in life.
If you only look at the victory right in front of you and chase recklessly...
you will surely lose sight of what is truly important.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
To continue for a long time. To keep running.
The mindset one must never forget for that sake is surely—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
—I'm going to have fun out there tomorrow.
Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And on the day of the event—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Deyaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Finals Opponent
text_block_list.text:
I-Impossible! After 50 years of playing with spinning tops...!
I, who was once hailed as the Top Granny, could lose to this...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus enjoyed herself and stayed relaxed
throughout the entire match, ultimately seizing
a brilliant victory.

text_block_list.name: Finals Duo
text_block_list.text:
"Deryaaaaah!!"
"Soryaaaaah!!"

text_block_list.name: Buzzing Crowd
text_block_list.text:
"Wha?! Both tops are spinning like tornadoes!"
"A-And... in such a fierce battle, how can they be fighting with such joyous smiles on their faces...?!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus ran freely and put on a fierce yet
refreshing final showdown, capturing the attention
of everyone in the crowd!

text_block_list.name: Finals Duo
text_block_list.text:
"Tei!"
"Toryaaaa!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Facing off against formidable opponents, Ikuno Dictus enjoyed the match more than anyone, advanced through the ranks, and earned a brilliant podium finish.
